## Improvements

- Automatic refresh now focuses on the provider you are viewing. Select **All providers** to refresh everything together. If you refresh while an update is already running, UsageDeck will run it next instead of ignoring it.
- Provider updates are less likely to get stuck when a provider's tool stops responding or returns unexpected data.
- If saved settings become unreadable, UsageDeck restores the defaults, tells you what happened, and keeps a copy of the old settings when possible.
- Sign-in alerts can now appear after the first failed update, followed by a recovery alert when the provider reconnects. Turning off provider status also stops any further status alerts.

## Fixes

- OpenAI Codex usage loads again with Codex CLI 0.149.0.
- Switching from GitHub Copilot back to OpenAI Codex no longer crashes UsageDeck.
